g.text: VEGFA full mRNA with nine aligned siRNA guides
NM_003376.6 | 3,609 nt | S-shaped reading order: follow the arrows
Orange: mRNA core sites | Blue: 19-nt guide cores | Gray: guide 3' duplex terminal 2 nt
Guide labels: candidate ID | 19-nt core interval. Full 21-nt guides are aligned antiparallel to the reference mRNA.
Gray terminal bases are duplex overhangs relative to the original passenger strand; they still match this mRNA reference.
All 3,609 reference bases are shown (T converted to U). Coordinates are 1-based. Overlapping candidates occupy separate lines.
